rachats.citation: Edward Don & Company On November 27, 2023, Sysco consummated its acquisition of Edward Don (or the acquiree) through a merger between Edward Don and a wholly owned subsidiary of Sysco Corporation, in which Sysco acquired 100 % of the members’ equity of the acquiree for cash consideration of $ 965 million.

_note: Rachats finalises depuis 2016 : balises XBRL des rapports annuels (allocation du prix d achat ou ecart d acquisition = rachat finalise) et Wikidata (entrees datees). Petites acquisitions non nommees par la societe absentes.
